Overview

Davao City is a city in Davao with a population of 1,776,000. Mindanao’s largest city and a model of urban planning, known for its safety, Mount Apo, and durian fruit. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
